main_measure.name: pooled excess forward 5-bar return after forecast <= -10 (vs coin/window mean 5-bar return)
main_measure.threshold: confirm if pooled excess < 0 with t <= -2 and negative in >= 2 of 3 coins; reject if pooled excess > 0 with t >= +2; inconclusive otherwise or if < 30 cases

supporting_check.name: number of coins with negative mean excess return (need >= 2)

decided_by: The t-statistic lies strictly between -2 and +2, so the plan rules inconclusive.
reading: Extreme cases are grid bars (positions 0,5,10,... of each window) with forecast <= -10, the holding baseline is the mean 5-bar forward return over all bars of that coin and window that have one, and with only the coins present in the record the coin rule still requires at least 2 coins negative.
